candidates.change_summary: Removed the onlyOwner guard invocation by replacing the body to call withdraw with msg.sender instead of using onlyOwner modifier (allows anyone to trigger withdrawal to themselves), changing observable post-withdrawAll balance behavior.
Change withdrawal recipient from msg.sender (via withdraw) to owner by directly calling withdraw(owner), so withdrawAll sends funds to owner regardless of caller.

Invert the onlyOwner check to require msg.sender != owner, so functions guarded by onlyOwner (including withdrawAll) can be called by anyone except the owner, altering who can trigger the withdrawAll observable behavior.
Replace transfer to send remaining gas and return boolean (ignoring result), which can change behavior when recipient is a contract that consumes more gas or reverts on transfer.
Replace transfer with a require around transfer to revert on failed send, changing whether withdraw reverts or silently fails.
Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender is not the owner, flipping the access control and thus changing who can call withdraw.
Replace low-level call with a call that checks the return value and reverts on failure, changing whether sendMoney can silently fail.
Replace low-level call with a call to a target using transfer instead of call, changing how value is sent and whether fallback is invoked.
Remove the require check in onlyOwner so any caller can invoke owner-restricted functions, altering who can call sendMoney and thus observable state changes.
